name: DevOps and SRE
goal: Training for whoever keeps the operation running: systems, networks, cloud, automation and observability. Sequence based on the community DevOps roadmap at roadmap.sh. Half the courses come from earlier tracks — anyone who did Front-end or Back-end starts halfway there.

courses.note: The roadmap does not choose, and neither does this track. What the job needs is one language you automate well in: Python is what most infrastructure teams write, Go is what Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform are themselves written in, and JavaScript is the one you may already have from the web.

Everything up to here is deliberately provider-agnostic — containers, Terraform, the pipeline — and that is the point of the tooling. This is where it stops: the accounts, the permissions, the network and the bill have a different shape on each provider, and Terraform has to be pointed at one of them. Going deeper into a single provider — its compute services and its managed operations — is the Cloud Engineering track.
